name: Jurançon

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

climate: Seasons this mild ripen Cabernet Franc, Cabernet Sauvignon, Riesling, Chardonnay and Sauvignon Blanc fully without cooking off their freshness.
Cabernet Franc and Cabernet Sauvignon sit in their sweet spot, so the wines can show the style they are known for.

soil.rock: Sand is warm and airy. It drains fast but holds little water, and phylloxera does not thrive in it. Limestone makes alkaline soil that drains well yet can hold water for the vines. It is usually planted to grapes valued for their acidity.
soil.top: The topsoil drains well and still stores water for dry spells, so vines grow evenly. Its pH is close to neutral, so vines take up the nutrients they need easily.

land: Much of it is steep. Cold air and rain run off, so frost and waterlogging are rare and soils stay thin, keeping yields low. Steep rows are slow and costly to work, often by hand.

winkler: Early and mid-season grapes make good wine.
